WITH hand_counts AS (
    SELECT p.bats, COUNT(*) AS record_count
    FROM appearances AS a
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id
    GROUP BY p.bats
)
SELECT bats,
       record_count,
       record_count * 1.0 / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share_of_total,
       record_count * 1.0 / AVG(record_count) OVER () AS ratio_to_average
FROM hand_counts;
